sections.Profile:
The Gemini pinball machine, manufactured by Gottlieb in 1978, is one of the last electro-mechanical (EM) games produced by the company. Designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison, it is a rare two-player game with only 300 units made.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1978
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Original Theme, Astrology, 1970s, Fantasy
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Gordon Morison
- Design: Ed Krynski
